user.title: Connect GRAAS
user.description: In the GRAAS app open Settings → Home Assistant, create a token and paste it here. The token is shown only once.

data_description.api_url: Leave as is. Only for development or testing servers.

reauth_confirm.title: GRAAS token no longer works
reauth_confirm.description: The token was revoked or replaced in the GRAAS app. Create a new one there and paste it here.

error.invalid_auth: GRAAS did not accept this token. It may have been revoked.
error.invalid_token_format: A GRAAS token starts with graas_pat_.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach GRAAS. Check the internet connection and try again.

abort.already_configured: This GRAAS account is already added.
abort.wrong_account: This token belongs to a different GRAAS account.

start_zone.name: Start zone
start_zone.description: Water GRAAS zones for a time or a volume. Runs always end on their own.

duration_minutes.name: Minutes
duration_minutes.description: How long to water (1–120). Use this or litres.

liters.name: Litres
liters.description: How much water (needs a flow meter, up to 2000). On Irigator controllers this is per plant. Use this or minutes.

dashboard.name: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Builds a ready-made watering dashboard from your GRAAS controllers and zones. Copy the yaml from the response into a new dashboard (Edit → ⋮ → Raw configuration editor).
